mechanism_narrative: Sustained negative RETAIL_REC trend (-13.6 to -11.9 over four weeks) reflects a stable suppression regime. Absent a reversal trigger in WORKPLACES or TRANSIT, this suppression persists into the next four weeks, keeping RETAIL_REC below baseline.

failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises above -8.0 in any week of the next four weeks, or mean RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days exceeds the mean of the last 28 days.

failure_condition: WORKPLACES rises above 0.0 and sustains for two weeks while RETAIL_REC simultaneously declines, or RETAIL_REC mean over next 28 days exceeds last 28 days mean.

failure_condition: TRANSIT recovers above -5.0 within one week and RETAIL_REC does not rise correspondingly, or RETAIL_REC mean over next 28 days exceeds last 28 days mean despite TRANSIT remaining below -8.0.
